verdict.rationale: Bugbot automatically reviews every PR, flagging bugs, security issues, and code quality problems, with manual trigger via PR comment and support across GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Azure DevOps; Automations also offer Security Agents and PR Routing bots layering contextual review. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of review quality and no evidence on false-positive rates or reviewer trust from community sources.
